global_rules: Do not pool raw scores across populations with different evidence class, topology, time cadence, label construction or task ground truth.
Every dataset release, exact file list and licence decision must be pinned before admission.
Keep every physical event and all of its windows in one partition; do not split adjacent overlapping windows across train and test.
Purge label windows and event buffers across temporal partition boundaries.
Fit preprocessing, scaling, feature selection, calibration and thresholds on training data only.
Report sensor count, measurement principles, sampling frequency, missingness and lifecycle cost with every result.
An unknown or physically unidentifiable location must be represented as an ambiguity set or abstention, not a forced pipe label.
A data paper, benchmark record or source-code listing is not proof that raw bytes or their redistribution rights have been admitted.

T1_detection.definition: Detect an event within the time resolution and event-label precision supported by the source.

T2_localization.definition: Estimate zone, segment or pipe only when ground-truth location and physical observability support that resolution.

T3_characterization.definition: Estimate leak flow or severity only where independent ground truth supports a quantitative target.

baseline_ladder.name: Persistence / last valid state
baseline_ladder.notes: Preserve missing data; no_report is not normal.

baseline_ladder.name: Water balance / minimum-night-flow
baseline_ladder.notes: Use only when zone boundaries, demand and metrology are fit for the method.

baseline_ladder.name: Random Forest / XGBoost
baseline_ladder.notes: Tabular baseline with explicit feature and sensor budget.

baseline_ladder.name: CNN / temporal model
baseline_ladder.notes: Sequence split by event/time, not random overlapping windows.

baseline_ladder.name: GNN / spatiotemporal graph model
baseline_ladder.notes: Graph revision and held-out network protocol required.

baseline_ladder.name: Multimodal fusion
baseline_ladder.notes: Ablate each sensing principle and common-cause dependency; fusion only earns credit for measured incremental value.

populations.native_resolution: hourly simulated states; 24-hour and annual horizons
populations.label_granularity: normal hydraulic state; no leak-positive labels admitted
populations.split_policy: Leave-network-out and simulation-seed-out; never relabel normal-only states as leak-negative without a documented event-generation design.

populations.native_resolution: scenario-dependent; verify from archive before admission
populations.label_granularity: synthetic leak scenario; exact label and sensor schema require file audit
populations.split_policy: Hold out complete generated scenarios and network/topology IDs; reproduce original generator/scoring split before any alternative split.

populations.native_resolution: 30-second signals; 51.2 kHz accelerometer/dynamic pressure; 8 kHz hydrophone
populations.label_granularity: controlled induced leak type and no-leak; location/magnitude granularity requires raw-file audit
populations.split_policy: Group by complete physical experiment/configuration; hold out leak mechanisms, topology or sensor locations for transfer. Never split overlapping segments from one 30-second record across partitions.

populations.label_granularity: binary fault_d7 label derived using a plus/minus seven-day event window
populations.split_policy: Blocked chronological split; purge at least the full label window plus a preregistered buffer at boundaries; event records and all affected hours remain within one partition. Do not report precise onset/lead time or T2 pipe localization from fault_d7.

populations.label_granularity: competition-defined leakage events and model-based location with economic response scoring
populations.split_policy: Preserve official 2018 historical/training and 2019 evaluation split and official scoring/economic rules; no random window repartition for the headline reproduction.

populations.native_resolution: EPANET/WNTR scenario resolution; exact artifact metadata unavailable
populations.label_granularity: paper-reported simulated leak detection/localization; exact label definitions pending artifact recovery
populations.split_policy: Do not create a replacement split and call it reproduction. Recover exact generator, scenario files, split, seed, sensor budget and scorer first.

populations.native_resolution: DAS; effective gauge length 2.6 m; raw trace sampling/format require acquisition audit
populations.label_granularity: controlled valve leak events on one route; not natural leak events
populations.split_policy: Hold out complete valve events, route segments and environmental periods; if only one route, report within-route transfer only and retain route-specific coupling calibration.

populations.label_granularity: leakage, cyberattack and sensor-failure events as described; counts/locations require file audit
populations.split_policy: Group by complete physical event and testbed configuration; keep leak, cyberattack and sensor failure as separate classes. Do not merge with LeakTestbed without archive-level equivalence proof.

targets_not_achieved.T1: Investigate >=95% recall at a pre-registered false-alarm budget on each eligible held-out population; do not substitute pooled accuracy.
targets_not_achieved.T2: Investigate >=25% lower P95 localization distance than the strongest reproduced baseline at equal sensor budget and equal physical identifiability coverage.
targets_not_achieved.T3: Investigate calibrated magnitude intervals with >=90% empirical coverage on an independently labelled population where measured leak flow ground truth exists.
targets_not_achieved.sensor_efficiency: Produce a Pareto curve over sensor count, lifecycle cost, observability and maintenance; no weighted winner without an explicitly approved utility profile.
